name: abyigiter-mods
description: Claude Code mods by Bugra Yigiter: a live usage, cost and git band above the prompt.

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: See your Claude Code session at a glance: context left, cost and today's spend, rate limits, git diff and PR status, right above the prompt. Set /budget limits and get a toast before you go over. Open the detail panel for context breakdown, turns, cache hit rate and top tools. Works in the CLI and the desktop Code tab.
